intro: The Adventurer is a breadcrumb assignment given by Marshal McBride in Northshire Valley. Recognising your early competence, McBride directs you beyond the cloistered abbey grounds toward Goldshire to look into a newcomer named Sam Sarsaparilla.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend Briarthorn, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.
I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I appreciate the lookin' out, adventurer. That marshal's just a worrywart.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
